name: User - Invalid Mobile Number Retry
goal: Verify that the bot correctly handles an invalid mobile number and prompts for re-entry until valid.
constraints: User enters invalid mobile number first, then valid on retry.

phases.description: User starts new application and enters invalid mobile number.
phases.completionCriteria: Bot rejects invalid number and prompts again.
Bot accepts and proceeds to next input.

manualPrereqs: Chrome must be open and logged into Google Chat as the test user
